prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Personalize & Confirm Your Desktop Companion", "Review your pet's adoption certificate and customize traits before finalizing.", "Live Pet Preview", "Verified Desktop Companion"]
1: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to summon, chat, dock, or temporarily hide your pet on your desktop.", "Control Shortcuts", "Got It!"]
2: ["Assembling Your Desktop Pet", "Your companion is being built and prepared for desktop launch.", "Estimated Time Remaining", "Generation Progress"]
3: ["Select Your Pet Companion Journey", "Swipe to explore companion personality paths tailored for work, fun, or relaxation.", "Companion Archetypes"]
4: ["Signing in secures your pet traits, items, and progress safely in cloud backup.", "Cloud Sync Protected"]
5: ["Calibrate Your Custom Pet Photo", "Adjust bounds and lighting so your pet renders cleanly on your desktop.", "Adjust Pet Frame", "Confirm & Generate"]
6: ["Enable desktop notifications so you're alerted when your companion appears on screen."]
7: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Use these quick shortcuts to interact, chat, or position your pet on screen.", "Quick Interactions", "Launch Desktop Pet"]
8: ["Pick Your Ideal Desktop Friend in 1 Click", "Choose how your pet interacts with your desktop workflow—productivity partner, quiet companion, or playful buddy."]
9: ["Preparing Desktop Companion", "Finalizing pet animations, sound effects, and desktop widget bindings."]
